logic: PR = Population / UIO. PR 6 implies 166.7 motorcycles in use per 1,000 inhabitants. Structural annual flow = expected cohort deaths + 6% of remaining UIO headroom. The structural flow is blended with the unconstrained forecast with increasing weight by horizon; current KI remains driven by actuals and short-term forecast.
governance: UIO is a stock of motorcycles in use, not registrations.
Replacement demand is driven by cohort retirements; expansion demand is constrained by remaining headroom to PR 6.
PR 6 is an explicit planning assumption and must be visible in methodology.
The current closed actuals are never modified by the saturation layer.
The saturation layer bends the multi-year KI forecast; it does not mechanically cap an individual month.
